title.en: Stay on one row while resolving which published sprayer matches the interior hydraulic mortar photo
title.zh: 选型时不要并格：室内液压砂浆喷涂的工厂实拍，对哪一台已公布机器

description.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. Open the hydraulic concrete spraying machine first. Xingtai-based Hebei Pinjin Machinery publishes that factory photo as hydraulic mortar spraying inside a building, and the matching catalogue row is 380 V, all-copper dual motors 7.5/9 kW, 5 m³/h, 8 MPa, hose 38/51 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, particle ≤8 mm, 100 m horizontal / 50 m vertical, 295 kg. Keep this cell as published. The photo does not name a jobsite, a floor count or a country project. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. M9 stays on plaster at 30 L/min and ≤4 mm. Read it in the Xingtai table. A pipeline pour stays on a pump page.
description.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：先打开液压混凝土喷涂机。邢台河北品锦机械把这张工厂图公布为建筑室内的液压砂浆喷涂，对得上的目录行是 380V、全铜双电机 7.5/9 kW、5 m³/h、8 MPa、管径 38/51 mm、砂灰比 ≤1:3、粒径 ≤8 mm、水平 100 m / 垂直 50 m、295 kg。这张图没有工地名称、楼层数或国家工程。M9 仍是 30 L/min、≤4 mm 的石膏。走管道的浇筑仍在泵的页面。

h1.en: Stay on one row while resolving which published sprayer matches the interior hydraulic mortar photo
h1.zh: 选型时不要并格：室内液压砂浆喷涂的工厂实拍，对哪一台已公布机器

Xingtai-based Hebei Pinjin Machinery publishes that factory photo as hydraulic mortar spraying inside a building, and the matching catalogue row is 380 V, all-copper dual motors 7.5/9 kW, 5 m³/h, 8 MPa, hose 38/51 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, particle ≤8 mm, 100 m horizontal / 50 m vertical, 295 kg. Read it in the Xingtai table. A pipeline pour stays on a pump page.
directAnswer.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：先打开液压混凝土喷涂机。邢台河北品锦机械把这张工厂图公布为建筑室内的液压砂浆喷涂，对得上的目录行是 380V、全铜双电机 7.5/9 kW、5 m³/h、8 MPa、管径 38/51 mm、砂灰比 ≤1:3、粒径 ≤8 mm、水平 100 m / 垂直 50 m、295 kg。这张图没有工地名称、楼层数或国家工程。M9 仍是 30 L/min、≤4 mm 的石膏。走管道的浇筑仍在泵的页面。

body.en: The section shape comes from “Etymology” in “Lime mortar”. The sentences are a restatement of the catalogue, not of that article. Read it in the Xingtai table. The Xingtai factory photo set shows hydraulic mortar spraying inside a building. Taken from the printed row: The photo does not name a jobsite, a floor count or a country project. Keep this cell as published. Do not turn a column, a scissor lift or a sign in the background into a contract, a city job or a storey count. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Type 311 is ≤2 mm and 15 m / 5 m. Read it in the Xingtai table. Do not attach a project name the factory page does not print. Taken from the printed row: M9 prints 30 L/min, ≤4 mm, a 25 mm hose, 50 m / 20 m and 380 V/50 Hz. Keep this cell as published. Electric 15 prints 8–10 m³/h, 1–3 cm aggregate and a 100–125 mm pipe. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lime_mortar
body.zh: 这一节的形状来自《Lime mortar》的“词源”。文字是目录的转述，不是那篇文章的原文。按邢台表上的原文理解：邢台工厂图集是建筑室内的液压砂浆喷涂。先打开 380V、7.5/9 kW、5 m³/h 那一行。图集没有项目名称，也没有楼层数。目录里已经写着：没有。工厂说明印的是机型和室内喷涂场景。没有项目名称、楼层数或国家工程。图来自来源页面：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lime_mortar

body.en: “Lime mortar” breaks its subject at “History”. Here the same break only holds the cells this model already prints. Taken from the printed row: Open the 380 V, 7.5/9 kW, 5 m³/h row first. Keep this cell as published. M9 stays on plaster at 30 L/min and ≤4 mm. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The spraying solution page still separates spraying from pipeline placement, and this frame stays on the spraying side. Read it in the Xingtai table. None of these rows is Electric 15 or Electric 20. Taken from the printed row: No. Keep this cell as published. The hydraulic row on this photo’s caption prints 5 m³/h and ≤8 mm. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. That is not the 38/51 mm spraying hose on the 5 m³/h row.
body.zh: 《Lime mortar》在“沿革”处把题目拆开。这里这一段只放这台机器已经印出的格子。先打开液压混凝土喷涂机。河北品锦机械（邢台）把这张工厂图公布为建筑室内的液压砂浆喷涂，对得上的目录行是 380V、全铜双电机 7.5/9 kW、5 m³/h、8 MPa、管径 38/51 mm、砂灰比 ≤1:3、粒径 ≤8 mm、水平 100 m / 垂直 50 m、295 kg。这张图没有工地名称、楼层数或国家工程。M9 仍是 30 L/min、≤4 mm 的石膏。走管道的浇筑仍在泵的页面。这一格照已印出的读：不是。M9 印的是 30 L/min、≤4 mm、25 mm 软管、50 m / 20 m、380V/50Hz。这张图说明对应的液压行印的是 5 m³/h 和 ≤8 mm。

body.en: Borrow “Uses” from “Lime mortar” as the skeleton, and fill it with the printed window for this page. Keep this cell as published. It names no project and no floor count. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. A pipeline pour stays on a pump page. Read it in the Xingtai table. Stay on the 295 kg hydraulic machine when the room can supply 380 V and the hose stays inside 100 m / 50 m with particle ≤8 mm. Taken from the printed row: Send the material, the largest particle, whether the job is mortar, concrete or grout, the hose length you measured, and whether the room has 380 V. Keep this cell as published. The factory caption prints the machine class and an interior spraying scene. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. When you need the published 7 m³/h, 11/15 kW and 150 m / 70 m window, including grout.
body.zh: 把《Lime mortar》的“用途”借来当骨架，里面填的是本页这一格已经印出的窗口。邢台工厂页把这一帧写成建筑室内的液压砂浆喷涂机。公布出来的场景就是这些。先不要把背景里的柱子、升降车或牌子写成合同、城市工程或楼层数。喷涂方案页仍然把喷涂和管道浇筑分开，这一帧留在喷涂这一侧。旁边那一台不在这句话里。当需要目录里的 7 m³/h、11/15 kW 和 150 m / 70 m，包括灌浆料时。那是大流量液压喷涂机，仍然是 380V 和 ≤8 mm。

body.en: The reference page “Lime mortar” uses “Hydraulic and non-hydraulic lime” as one of its own divisions. What follows is the Xingtai row, said again in different words. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Open the hydraulic concrete spraying machine first. Read it in the Xingtai table. The factory page in Xingtai captions this frame as a hydraulic mortar spraying machine inside a construction building. Taken from the printed row: Step to the high-flow hydraulic sprayer only when the catalogue need is 7 m³/h, 11/15 kW, 650 kg and 150 m / 70 m, including the grout line printed on that page. Keep this cell as published. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. It does not print a project name, a floor count or a national job. Read it in the Xingtai table. That is the high-flow hydraulic sprayer, still 380 V and ≤8 mm.
body.zh: 来源页《Lime mortar》用“液压和非液压石灰”划分这一节。后面是邢台目录里已有内容，换一种说法写下。旁边那一台不在这句话里。房间能供 380V，软管落在 100 m / 50 m 内、粒径 ≤8 mm 时，留在 295 kg 这台液压机。只有目录需求是 7 m³/h、11/15 kW、650 kg 和 150 m / 70 m 时，才升到大流量液压喷涂机，那一页还印了灌浆料。德式砂浆是另一行：3–5 m³/h、≤5 mm、40 m / 20 m。311 是 ≤2 mm 和 15 m / 5 m。这些行都不是电动15或电动20。按邢台表上的原文理解：只有作业是管道混凝土时才看它。电动15印的是 8–10 m³/h、骨料 1–3 cm、管径 100–125 mm。那不是 5 m³/h 行上的 38/51 mm 喷涂软管。

body.en: “Mix” is an outline label from “Lime mortar”. That label does not add a figure to the printed row. Read it in the Xingtai table. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai publishes that factory photo as hydraulic mortar spraying inside a building, and the matching catalogue row is 380 V, all-copper dual motors 7.5/9 kW, 5 m³/h, 8 MPa, hose 38/51 mm, sand-cement ratio ≤1:3, particle ≤8 mm, 100 m horizontal / 50 m vertical, 295 kg. Taken from the printed row: That is the whole published scene. Keep this cell as published. German type mortar is a different row: 3–5 m³/h, ≤5 mm, 40 m / 20 m. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai quotes these sprayers without a published list price. Read it in the Xingtai table. No. Taken from the printed row: Only if the job is pipeline concrete.
body.zh: “混合料”是《Lime mortar》大纲上的标题。这个标题不给已印出的行增加数字。按邢台表上的原文理解：请发材料、最大粒径、作业是砂浆、混凝土还是灌浆料、量到的软管长度，以及房间有没有 380V。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。邢台河北品锦机械对这些喷涂机询价报价，没有公开标价。不要附上工厂页没有印出的项目名称。

question.en: “Etymology” does not change the check: Does this interior photo name a building or a country job?
question.zh: “词源”不改这一问：这张室内实拍点名了某栋楼或某个国家工程吗？

answer.en: No. The factory caption prints the machine class and an interior spraying scene. It leaves that cell blank for a project name, a floor count or a national job.
answer.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：没有。工厂说明印的是机型和室内喷涂场景。没有项目名称、楼层数或国家工程。

question.en: Is the same frame the M9 plaster machine, once the outline says “History”?
question.zh: 大纲写着“沿革”时，同一帧是 M9 石膏机吗？

answer.en: Taken from the printed row: No. M9 prints 30 L/min, ≤4 mm, a 25 mm hose, 50 m / 20 m and 380 V/50 Hz. The hydraulic row on this photo’s caption prints 5 m³/h and ≤8 mm.
answer.zh: 目录里已经写着：不是。M9 印的是 30 L/min、≤4 mm、25 mm 软管、50 m / 20 m、380V/50Hz。这张图说明对应的液压行印的是 5 m³/h 和 ≤8 mm。

question.en: Under “Uses”, when does the interior job leave the 5 m³/h machine?
question.zh: 在“用途”这一节里，室内作业什么时候离开 5 m³/h 这台？

answer.en: Keep this cell as published. When you need the published 7 m³/h, 11/15 kW and 150 m / 70 m window, including grout. That is the high-flow hydraulic sprayer, still 380 V and ≤8 mm.
answer.zh: 这一格照已印出的读：当需要目录里的 7 m³/h、11/15 kW 和 150 m / 70 m，包括灌浆料时。那是大流量液压喷涂机，仍然是 380V 和 ≤8 mm。
